scope: Existing 20 interaction tests with API fixtures. Provided Playwright runtime; application and assertions unchanged.

tests.title: mobile first screen exposes the lookup, metadata and all relative runtime assets
keyboard validation focuses the address and Enter loads real-shaped wallet data
precise SQK amounts are truncated explicitly and full precision remains accessible
unknown rewards and staking are never shown as zero or complete holdings
unavailable and malformed responses report failures instead of empty holdings
an empty wallet has a real zero count and a usable next step
rate limiting honors Retry-After and recovers through the primary action
network failure and timeout give a recoverable error, with static site intact
asset failures and mismatched releases do not fabricate a formatted SQK balance
Genesis code and link lookups show clout only, independently of the wallet
invalid profile hosts, missing profiles, and profiles without clout have clear states
collection pagination keeps the same safe snapshot and filters across loaded pages
pagination rejects changed snapshots and keeps the previously loaded collection
layout reflows without clipping at representative widths, enlarged text and RTL
accessibility scan covers initial, populated and expanded badge states
reduced motion suppresses the loading spinner and maintains a text cue
amount and input edge cases preserve precision and reject invalid data
cross-site profile failure offers a local import with an honest snapshot label
snapshot import validates JSON, focuses errors, and rejects another profile code
snapshot schema rejects unavailable, oversized and incomplete payloads
